name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: The best cross-department improvement is to standardize transcript formatting across all agents before they reach Reel. This ensures Reel spends zero time cleaning or reformatting, cutting total turnaround time by 30%. The trade-off is a one-time 2-hour setup for each agent to adopt a shared template, but the payoff scales with every future transcript.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t wasted hours on corrections—it’s locking editors into a tool that can’t adapt when transcript needs shift. Instead, standardize the *output format* (JSON with clear fields) but let agents generate raw text; Reel handles final formatting. Settle it by testing both: measure turnaround time with raw vs. templated transcripts over two weeks.
